radarPulses.findings: Mortgage rates and benchmark yields remain steady at elevated levels (US 30-yr FRM at 7.40%, 10-yr Treasury at 5.05%–5.10%, UK 30-yr gilt at 6.01%). In algorithmic trading discussions, the 'half rule'—expecting live trading Sharpe ratios to be approximately half of in-sample backtest figures due to slippage and changing market volatility regimes—reaffirms trader focus on downside risk (Sortino) and high-throughput columnar Parquet storage.
